name: How long does a typical copper pipe replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical copper pipe replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of copper pipe replacement depends on the extent of the work. Replacing a small section due to a localized leak might take a few hours. A full home repipe could span several days, typically between 3 to 5 days, depending on the home's size and complexity. Our technicians work efficiently to complete the project within the estimated timeframe, aiming to restore your water service as quickly as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small sections can take hours; a full home repipe typically takes 3-5 days, depending on home size and complexity.
